baseline_models.focus_anchor: The noun jazaan and adjectival wifaqan form a two-term construction: a return characterized by fit.
baseline_models.mechanism: The dominant J-Z-Y branch supplies requital that answers an act, while W-F-Q supplies both mutual conformity and an exactly sufficient measure. The phrase therefore presents consequence as calibrated correspondence, not merely as an unspecified penalty.

activation_trace.role: Recompense matching an act supplies the reciprocal return at the center of the mechanism.
Accordant fitting between two things makes the act and its return mutually conformable.
A measure exactly fitting its need or peer sharpens conformity into calibrated extent.

changed_reading.before: A recompense described generally as fitting.
changed_reading.after: A reciprocal consequence whose kind or extent is calibrated to the act it answers.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Jazaan can function as settlement language, and wifaqan specifies exact sufficiency.
baseline_models.mechanism: J-Z-Y can describe something that stands in for an obligation or the collection of a debt. Joined to W-F-Q's no-surplus sufficiency, the phrase can be read as a liability fully discharged by the precise due.

activation_trace.role: Standing in and sufficing supplies the idea of a consequence discharging an obligation.
Collecting or demanding a debt casts the recompense as settlement of an outstanding due.
Exact sufficiency fixes the settlement at the fitting amount rather than an arbitrary one.

changed_reading.before: A punishment corresponding to prior conduct.
changed_reading.after: A precise settlement that answers and exhausts an incurred liability.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Wifaqan can mark an event coinciding with its proper occasion, modifying the recompense noun.
baseline_models.mechanism: The fit may be temporal as well as scalar: recompense comes upon its object when consequence and proper occasion meet. This preserves requital while treating timing as part of its correspondence.

activation_trace.role: Act-matching recompense supplies the event whose arrival is being timed.
Coming upon something in coincidence supplies encounter rather than amount alone.
An event meeting its proper time makes punctual arrival a possible dimension of fit.

changed_reading.before: A consequence equal in quality or quantity.
changed_reading.after: A requital that also meets its recipient at the fitting occasion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah opens with mutual questioning about an incoming report, divergent paths around it, and promised disclosure; later it names denial as false and the day as reality. Against that arc, wifaqan can mark an epistemic accord: experienced outcome finally conforms knowledge to the disputed report.

activation_trace.role: Act-matching recompense remains the focus event that produces the changed cognition.
Accordant fitting supplies convergence between report, reality, and eventual knowledge.
Mutual questioning supplies the initial unsettled social state.
The arriving, communicated report supplies the proposition whose truth will be encountered.
Taking divergent paths supplies the mismatch that later accord resolves.
Disclosure to the knower supplies the promised transition from dispute to recognition.
Contradiction of truth identifies the epistemic failure answered by the recompense.
Reality fixed against falsehood supplies the terminal pole with which knowledge comes into accord.

structural_cues: 78:1-5 moves from questioning and disagreement to the doubled promise that they will know; 78:28 and 78:39 later oppose denial to the real day.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dispute, report, promised knowing, denial, and reality; I infer that the recompense is the event that forces those terms into accord. A live alternative is that these cues establish certainty while wifaqan remains only conduct-to-penalty proportionality.

changed_reading.before: A penalty fitted to an act.
changed_reading.after: A fitted consequence that also makes experienced reality agree with the report previously disputed and denied.

context_deltas.mechanism: The made states of earth, sleep, night, day, and lamp sit beside images of measuring a creation, driving a stabilizing stake, and joining a built structure. This makes the focus fit resemble engineered placement within an ordered system: consequence is proportioned with the same functional exactness as the surrounding arrangements.

activation_trace.role: Act-matching recompense supplies the moral relation to which ordered measure is applied.
Exact fit to need or peer supplies the calibrated design principle.
Making a thing into a functional state begins the sequence of purposeful arrangements.
The driven stake supplies exact placement and fastening as a material analogy for fit.
Measuring and proportioning a thing supplies calibration before realization.
Joining parts into a construction supplies systemic composition rather than isolated equivalence.

structural_cues: 78:6-16 repeatedly assigns created things complementary functions and links water to the production of grain, plants, and enfolding gardens.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies making, measuring, fastening, and joining; I infer that their functional order sharpens wifaqan into engineered proportionality. The alternative is that the sequence demonstrates power without defining the mode of recompense.

changed_reading.after: A consequence placed and measured with the functional exactness displayed in the surah's ordered world.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Day is a bounded duration, the separation has a fixed appointment, and the final warning makes punishment temporally near. These cues activate W-F-Q's proper-occasion branch and turn settlement into something punctual: the due not only fits but arrives at its assigned moment.

activation_trace.role: Debt collection supplies the settlement event whose due time matters.
An event meeting its proper occasion directly supplies temporal fit.
A duration of time gives the appointed event a temporal container.
A known time fixes the settlement rather than leaving its arrival indefinite.
Temporal nearness brings the appointed consequence into the warning's present horizon.

structural_cues: 78:17 calls the Day of Separation a fixed appointment, and 78:40 closes by warning of a near punishment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a named day, fixed time, and temporal nearness; I infer that these select the occasion sense within wifaqan. The alternative is that they date the event while its fit remains exclusively qualitative or quantitative.

changed_reading.before: An exact settlement with unspecified timing.
changed_reading.after: An exact settlement whose arrival itself coincides with the fixed and now-near occasion.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier, delivered and pouring water brings hidden grain and vegetation outward; immediately before the focus, cooling and drink are denied except for hot water and a flowing discharge. The matched consequence can therefore operate as a reversal inside the same provision channel: life-bearing flow becomes unrelieving intake and outflow.

activation_trace.role: Act-answering recompense authorizes reading the reversed fluid sequence as consequential return.
Mutual fitting connects the beneficial and punitive fluid systems as corresponding forms.
Delivering water by irrigation or pouring supplies the beneficial input channel.
Pouring and downflow give the provision sequence its abundant motion.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies the productive result of the water.
Taking in liquid supplies the bodily channel that the punitive exception frustrates.
Hot water reverses the expected cooling and relief of drink.
Flowing and pouring echo the earlier motion while changing its material result.

structural_cues: 78:14-16 forms a water-to-life sequence, while 78:24-25 negates cooling and drink before naming two punitive fluids; 78:26 labels what precedes as fitting recompense.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel fluid motions with opposed outcomes; I infer that the later sequence is a fitted inversion of provision. A live alternative is simple contrast between blessing and punishment without a channel-by-channel correspondence.

changed_reading.before: A penalty matching misconduct at an abstract moral level.
changed_reading.after: A sensory counter-provision in which the channels of water, flow, and intake return in an inverted, unrelieving form.

context_deltas.mechanism: The recipients are characterized by crossing a limit; their destination is already prepared on the path, becomes their place of return, and holds them in extended detention. Wifaqan thus supports a spatial reversal in kind: unbounded excess is answered by inescapable containment.

activation_trace.role: Act-answering recompense makes the spatial reversal consequential rather than merely scenic.
Accordant fitting links transgressive overflow to its counter-form of confinement.
Preparation in advance supplies a destination already fitted to intercept its recipients.
Crossing the limit in disobedience supplies the outward excess to be countered.
Return to a place turns outward transgression into arrival at a fixed terminus.
Remaining in a place supplies immobility after the return.
Detention supplies the binding consequence opposed to limit-breaking.

structural_cues: 78:21-23 moves in sequence from a prepared lookout, to the limit-crossers for whom it is a return-place, to their prolonged remaining there.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies limit-crossing, preparation, return, remaining, and detention; I infer a fitted reversal from excess to containment. The alternative is that the sequence identifies recipients and duration without encoding the punishment's form as a response to excess.

changed_reading.after: A punishment proportionate in spatial logic: crossing every bound returns as confinement within a prepared terminus.

context_deltas.mechanism: The denied reckoning is followed by total inclusion, exhaustive enumeration, and a written determination before the imperative to taste. These cues turn the focus's debt-settlement possibility into an audited liability: the fitted due is traceable to a complete record.

activation_trace.role: Demanding and collecting a debt supplies the liability model.
Exact sufficiency makes the recorded liability and its settlement commensurate.
Counting and calculation name the reckoning whose absence they expected.
Totality and enclosure prevent omitted items from escaping the account.
Exhaustive enumeration supplies itemized completeness.
A written determination that entails judgment gives the enumeration operative force.

structural_cues: 78:27 denies expected reckoning, 78:29 answers with comprehensive enumeration in a record, and 78:30 moves directly to tasting and increase.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies calculation, totality, enumeration, and binding record; I infer that the record grounds the exact settlement named at the focus. The alternative is evidentiary attestation without calculation of proportional amount.

changed_reading.before: A debt-like recompense whose basis is unstated.
changed_reading.after: An audited settlement whose exact due is supported by an exhaustive, judgment-bearing record.

context_deltas.mechanism: Jazaan recurs at 78:36, but the punitive qualifier wifaqan is replaced there by a sequence of lordly source, giving, and sufficiency. The repetition keeps both outcomes in one recompense category while the changed modifiers resist a flat symmetry: exact fit is locally foregrounded for punishment, whereas the favorable return is cast as nurturant gift and ample sufficiency.

activation_trace.role: The focus occurrence supplies the punitive member of the repeated recompense frame.
Exact sufficiency identifies the distinctive qualifier whose absence in 78:36 matters.
Sufficiency and enrichment let the favorable return be adequate without requiring bare one-for-one equivalence.
The repeated recompense noun places the favorable outcome in direct lexical comparison with the focus.
Nurturing, repairing, and completing characterize the source of the favorable recompense.
Giving and handing over cast the favorable recompense as gift rather than debt collection alone.

structural_cues: 78:26 and 78:36 repeat jazaan in the two outcome panels, but only the former is qualified by wifaqan and only the latter is expanded by source, gift, and hisaban.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lexical repetition and contrasting modifier environments; I infer that wifaqan locally constrains the punitive return while the favorable return remains open to gift-like sufficiency or surplus. A live alternative is that hisaban reasserts exact calculation and preserves full symmetry.

changed_reading.before: All recompense in the surah follows the same strict equivalence rule.
changed_reading.after: The focus marks punishment as exact fit, while the later recompense is framed through nurture, giving, and sufficiency, creating a potentially deliberate asymmetry.

context_deltas.mechanism: At the close, the person directly perceives what the hands advanced. This supplies the missing second term of the focus's fit: acquired action has been sent ahead and is encountered again, making recompense look less like an unrelated external imposition and more like one's own deed returned in consequential form.

activation_trace.role: Recompense matching an act supplies the return relation.
Accordant fitting joins the advanced deed to the consequence now encountered.
Directed sight or insight makes the relation experientially visible to the person.
Advancing something forward supplies the deed's prior projection toward the encounter.
What the hands acquired identifies personal action as the material now faced.

structural_cues: 78:40 places seeing, the individual, what was advanced, and the two hands in one clause immediately before the disbeliever's wish to be dust.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies perception, forward projection, and hand-acquired action; I infer that the advanced deed is the counterpart to which the focus consequence fits. The alternative is that deeds are only displayed as evidence before a separately imposed penalty.

changed_reading.before: A fitting sanction imposed on an offender from outside.
changed_reading.after: A fitting encounter in which the offender sees a personally acquired and previously advanced deed return as consequence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's non-dominant J-Z-Y to J-Z-Z split and reads cutting-season imagery beside the dominant recompense sense. It remains focus-anchored through the supplied split mapping and is reinforced by the seed, growth, separation, and proper-occasion cues. Downstream prose should present it only as an exploratory harvest analogy, never as a lexical replacement of jazaan.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The packet maps the focus root ج ز ي not only to recompense branches but also to a non-dominant cutting and harvest inventory.

activation_trace.role: Readiness for shearing or harvest supplies consequence as something ripened to its cutting-time.
The event meeting its proper occasion makes ripeness and harvest-time a form of fit.
The seed that grows supplies the beginning of a maturation sequence.
Growth emerging from earth supplies maturation toward harvest.
Separating one thing from another supplies the terminal division analogous to cutting ripe produce.

changed_reading.before: Recompense is an immediately assigned equivalent.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, consequence is a crop-like return that matures and is separated at its fitting harvest-time.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it activates W-F-Q's technical arrow-notch image and supplies the launch trajectory by inference. It remains anchored in wifaqan and gains visible support from the later target-hit, forward-advance, and hand-acquisition images. Render it only as a qualified mechanical analogy for alignment, not as a claim that the verse literally depicts a projectile.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Wifaqan carries a supplied technical branch of seating an arrow's notch on the bowstring.

activation_trace.role: Act-matching recompense identifies what the aligned mechanism delivers.
Seating an arrow notch onto the string supplies precise operational alignment before release.
Aimed impact on a target supplies the endpoint of the alignment analogy.
Forward advance supplies trajectory from prior action toward later encounter.
Hand-acquired deeds identify the agent's own action as what aligns the consequence.

changed_reading.before: A consequence statically measured against an act.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the act nocks and aligns its own consequence so that the return reaches its fitting target.

strongest_changes: Wifaqan expands from scalar equality to a punctual settlement fixed for an appointed and near day.
The sequence from limit-crossing to prepared return and detention makes punishment a spatial counter-form of transgression.
Counting, exhaustive enumeration, and binding record turn the debt model into an audited settlement.
The repeated jazaan at 78:36 revises flat symmetry by contrasting punitive exact fit with favorable nurture, gift, and sufficiency.
The closing sight of hand-advanced deeds makes the recompense readable as one's own action returning in consequential form.
summary.what_was_special: The two-word focus acted as a hinge rather than a closed formula: its fit branches absorbed epistemic, temporal, material, spatial, fiscal, and reflexive mechanisms from across the whole surah while remaining anchored in jazaan and wifaqan.
remaining_uncertainties: Wifaqan may select kind, amount, timing, or several dimensions of fit at once; the packet does not force one scope.
Hisaban at 78:36 can activate sufficiency or calculation, so the positive-negative asymmetry remains real but not decisive.
The creation-order and fluid-reversal models may be functional correspondences or rhetorical contrasts rather than causal explanations of the focus.
The harvest and arrow models depend on non-dominant or technical branches and must remain explicitly exploratory.
